subject: 藏地平顶石砌茶肆（原创扩展；历史细部待考）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Regenerate this same single Tibetan tea-house sprite, changing ONLY camera and ground-plan proportions for city-map alignment. Preserve the flat-roofed whitewashed stone tea house, dark trapezoid window surrounds, red band, wood balcony, tea porch, naturalistic detail and same light from screen upper left. Raise the view until BOTH ground axes have exactly absolute screen slope 0.5, forming a true 2:1 ground diamond, orthographic yaw45 pitch30. The existing view is too shallow. Make east-west 10 metres and north-south 8 metres: ground projected visible edges ratio exactly 1.25, not the present stretched wide front. The three visible corners should lie at normalized canvas positions approximately LEFT (0.16,0.65), FRONT (0.538,0.839), RIGHT (0.84,0.688) with hidden BACK (0.462,0.499), retaining an entire complete building above them. These are projected ground corners, not output markings. DO NOT print corner names, dimensions, annotations or grid. Keep all verticals vertical, opposite edges parallel. No thick display pedestal; thin paving only inside footprint. South entrance lower left. True transparent RGBA background; entire outline and tiny lower-right contact shadow inside generous transparent margin. Do not add people, text, modern objects, scenery, white background or checkerboard. No nonuniform deformation of building details; redraw the correct camera naturally.

prior.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE realistic ancient Tibetan regional city-map building sprite for tianshu, ID bld_kit_tubo_restaurant. A two-storey Tibetan tea house, broad flat earthen roof with low parapet, slightly battered whitewashed fieldstone walls, exposed brown stone base, dark trapezoid window frames and small dark wood balcony, restrained ochre-red band below parapet. On ground floor an open south-facing tea porch with low wooden benches, a small unmarked copper tea kettle and clay jars. A small plain fabric sunshade, no writing. This is an original generic Tibetan adaptation for premodern Lhasa/Shigatse/Chamdo settings, not a reconstruction of any named monument. Rectangular footprint exactly 10 metres east-west by 8 metres north-south; the two visible ground edges must have length ratio 10:8. Match the attached Song sprite only in naturalistic materials, detail density, restrained weathering and crisp game-map readability, replace its tiled roof and Chinese timber form entirely with Tibetan flat-roofed stone architecture. Strict orthographic 2:1 dimetric camera yaw45 pitch30: ground east axis down-right slope +0.5, north axis up-right slope -0.5, verticals upright, parallel edges. Thin ground-contact rectangle with visible left, front and right corners, no raised display slab. Main entrance faces screen lower left. Warm-neutral key light from screen upper left, very short soft contact shadow screen lower right. Entire building centered with generous >=10% genuinely transparent margin on all sides; actual RGBA alpha, no background, no checkerboard. No people, animals, text, lettering, symbols resembling writing, signs, watermarks, modern details, sky, scenery, outside road, thick diorama plinth, floating island, cartoon, miniature toy, perspective convergence, cropped roof or base. Do not reproduce the baseline's gray tiled roof. Single-view asset.
prior.rejection: 首候选底面轴斜率约+0.40/-0.43，过浅且宽深比偏大；第二候选改善但仍非严格几何批准

negative: 人物、动物、文字、现代物、天空、景观、厚展示地台、假透明、透视汇聚、光晕

references.role: 仅材质与细节密度参考；生成候选参考保持candidate

created_time_basis: 源文件mtime；非工具披露服务端时间

steps: transparent padding only; no alpha threshold, warp, repaint or flip

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工量取薄底面前侧三角点；后角按平行边推算；锚点为左右对角中点。未声称3D实测或严格正交批准。

notes: 已逐张view_image原图及规格化终图；写实材质、主体完整、无文字与现代物；纯几何规格化保留原alpha。单视图candidate，几何残差见geometry_qa；历史用途与占地为原创地域同构替换。
